mapper.select: SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.CAR_NO, TS.COMPANY_ID, TC.COMPANY_NM, TO_CHAR(TS.REQUEST_DT, 'MM.DD HH24:MI') AS REQUEST_DT, TS.PROC_ST FROM TR_SERVICE TS, TM_COMPANY TC WHERE TS.COMPANY_ID = TC.COMPANY_ID AND TS.REQUEST_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '00:00:00', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '23:59:59', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY TS.REQUEST_DT DESC

SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.CAR_NO, TS.COMPANY_ID, TC.COMPANY_NM, TO_CHAR(TS.REQUEST_DT, 'MM.DD HH24:MI') AS REQUEST_DT, TS.PROC_ST FROM TR_SERVICE TS, TM_COMPANY TC WHERE TS.COMPANY_ID = TC.COMPANY_ID AND TS.WORK_CD = 'NUMCHG' AND TS.REQUEST_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '00:00:00', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '23:59:59', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY TS.REQUEST_DT DESC

SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.WORK_CD, TS.CAR_NO, TS.COMPANY_ID, TC.COMPANY_NM, TO_CHAR(TS.REQUEST_DT, 'MM.DD HH24:MI') AS REQUEST_DT, TS.PROC_ST FROM TR_SERVICE TS, TM_COMPANY TC WHERE TS.COMPANY_ID = TC.COMPANY_ID AND TS.WORK_CD = 'OFFLINE' AND TS.REQUEST_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '00:00:00', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '23:59:59', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY TS.REQUEST_DT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TR_OWNERINFO ( SERVICE_ID, SEQ, REG_NO, DEBTOR_YN, UNION_YN, DEBTOR_NM, DEBTOR_GB, DEBTOR_RATIO, DEBTOR_ADDR, DSIGN_GB, DSIGN_HP_GB, DSIGN_HP_NO, DSIGN_TX, DSIGN_ST, DSIGN_DT, IDEN_ST, IDEN_DT, CONFIRM_NO, DEBTOR_ADDR_DT, DEBTOR_ROAD_CD, BIZ_NO ) VALUES ( #{SERVICE_ID}, #{SEQ}, PKG_COMMON.FN_ENCRYPT(#{REG_NO}), #{DEBTOR_YN}, #{UNION_YN}, #{DEBTOR_NM}, #{DEBTOR_GB}, #{DEBTOR_RATIO}, PKG_COMMON.FN_ENCRYPT(#{DEBTOR_ADDR}), #{DSIGN_GB}, #{DSIGN_HP_GB}, PKG_COMMON.FN_ENCRYPT(#{DSIGN_HP_NO}), #{DSIGN_TX}, #{DSIGN_ST}, DECODE(#{DSIGN_DT}, '', SYSDATE, TO_DATE(#{DSIGN_DT}, 'yyyy/mm/dd hh24:mi:ss')), #{IDEN_ST}, DECODE(#{DSIGN_DT}, '', SYSDATE, TO_DATE(#{DSIGN_DT}, 'yyyy/mm/dd hh24:mi:ss')), #{CONFIRM_NO}, PKG_COMMON.FN_ENCRYPT(#{DEBTOR_ADDR_DT}), #{DEBTOR_ROAD_CD}, #{BIZ_NO} )
